id: title:Gilbert09:stop reporting an exhausted monday com retry as an exception

review.posthog_relevance: Adds a helper method and test for identifying retryable errors in the Monday.com warehouse connector, supporting transient error recovery.
review.reason: Adds a new method `get_retryable_errors` returning a set containing the string '(retryable)' and a pytest parametrized test checking that error messages containing '(retryable)' match this set.
review.uncertainty: This score is assigned based solely on the presence of a localized helper and its test. The actual benefit depends on whether this helper is invoked and used to implement a retry strategy, which is not demonstrated in this hunk. The score does not account for the implementation of the retry behavior or its effectiveness.

observations.limitations: Only supplied hunk IDs are cited. No score assigned.

observations.behavior: Adds a new method get_retryable_errors returning a set containing the string '(retryable)' and a pytest parametrized test checking that error messages containing '(retryable)' match this set.
observations.posthog_connection: This could support a retry strategy for transient Monday.com API errors, allowing Temporal workflow activities to retry after exhausting in-process backoff, potentially improving warehouse ingestion reliability for this connector.
